failClosedRules: Reject the arm before evaluation if a requested model, canonical model, tool version, prompt hash, schema hash, exit code, raw-artifact hash, or raw tool-use evidence differs from this preregistration.
Reject the arm if a reviewer has different effective model sets in Conditions A and B.
Reject any unlisted auxiliary model. Record every modelUsage entry with nonzero aggregate token use.
If Run B uses claude-fable-5, interpret Run B as an effective-composition change rather than a pure primary-model substitution.

evidenceLimits.codex: The CLI event stream attests token usage and absence of tool-event types but does not provider-attest the effective model; the requested selector and exact CLI version are the available identity evidence.
evidenceLimits.claude: The raw Claude Code envelope must attest every modelUsage entry; metadata is rejected unless it matches the envelope exactly.
